background: Wells Fargo Bank, N.A. is the main operating bank of Wells Fargo, one of the four largest US banks, with the largest branch network in the country, serving consumers, small businesses and corporates across the United States.
synthesis: Rated AA- on average across all three, the weakest of them at A+, all three on a stable outlook, the operating bank sits well above its holding company. Leverage of 8.0% is in the top quarter of US banks, while CET1 of 12.1% is just below the median and LCR of 119% just above it. CET1 has fallen 1.2 points since 30 Jun 2025, while LCR has been broadly flat. The newest flagged item, on 7 Oct 2026, is a federal investigation into its homeownership programmes, a conduct matter rather than a credit one.
